why_best: Giving the interface physical depth elevates a standard feature highlight into an immersive, premium showcase tailored for high-converting promo feeds.
why_bad: A simple two-dimensional fade or slide would flatten the composition, making a flagship feature feel like a static screenshot rather than an engaging experience.
trap: An amateur execution will over-rotate the angles and turn the interface into an unreadable illusion rather than a polished product highlight.
